executor: Existing pg client independently verifies the already committed schema, then submits only the pinned grants.draft.sql once; no schema replay

target.endpointRule: Existing control URL only; verified TLS to .neon.tech; no Aurora/local database or alternate config fallback
target.bindingRule: Exact existing schema/table/function OIDs and owner attributes from the partial-installation receipt, unchanged old catalog and no runtime/LOGIN role collision must match before the remaining grants batch

artifacts.normalization: UTF-8; CRLF converted to LF; no other substitution
UTF-8; CRLF converted to LF; no other substitution

objects.implicitObjects: Retain and verify existing schema-generated constraints, indexes and internal foreign-key triggers; the remaining grants batch creates no schema, table or function

catalogVerification.oldObjects: Compare every saved old schema/role-membership/relation/function/trigger/RLS/default-ACL/database-ACL entry by its original identity and definition/ACL summary; reject any missing or modified old entry
catalogVerification.allowedAdditionsAfterSchema: Only deployment_release_owner and its installer memberships, the exact new schema/three tables/nine functions, their SQL-generated internal objects and owner default ACL
catalogVerification.allowedAdditionsAfterGrants: Also allow only the exact planner/executor/verifier NOLOGIN roles, their implicit creator memberships and the exact scoped function/schema grants
catalogVerification.unexpectedObjectsOrMemberships: Stop; never discard changed old entries, ignore a whole name prefix or replace the saved baseline
catalogVerification.functionDefinitions: Match each exact signature, owner, SECURITY DEFINER, fixed search_path and server-side prosrc SHA256 against the corresponding approved SQL function body; source body never printed

runtimePrivileges.installerOwnerMembership: Only in the remaining grants transaction temporarily SET=true, INHERIT=false; SET=false on completion; original creator ADMIN may remain

steps: Validate the new SHA, exact invocation/SQL artifacts and both preserved old attempts; prove the first schema COMMIT and zero grants submission from saved originals; consume only this new independent attempt

Read the fixed config once; on a fresh verified TLS connection use READ ONLY to inspect the exact existing schema, fixed object OIDs, function bodies/ACL, empty regular heaps, explicit/effective owner rights and old catalog; parents is explicitly text[] and role checks remain strict

Only after all existing-schema checks and writer default-read-only capability check pass, commit the read-only transaction and submit only the exact grants.draft.sql once with its own BEGIN/COMMIT; never execute schema.draft.sql

Use one independent new READ ONLY connection to verify four total NOLOGIN roles, exact original runtime function ACL, no owner/table privileges for runtime roles, unchanged existing schema/table/function OIDs, empty tables and unchanged old catalog
Save safe metadata/role observations and hashes locally, keep all old records/slots, leave runtime disabled; stop on mismatch/unknown without retry, down, compensation or expanded privilege
stopRules: No approval, expired original facts, changed files/target or existing schema OIDs/definitions/owner rights, old catalog changes or unexpected role names: no grants DDL
Existing schema verification failure: do not submit grants; no automatic schema recreation, permission adjustment or baseline replacement
Lost grants/COMMIT ACK: preserve UNKNOWN; do not resubmit and do not infer rollback; only preapproved remaining independent reads may record uncertainty
Any final mismatch or budget exhaustion stops; already committed schema/grants remain, no automatic cleanup/down/rollback or new connection
Old attempts and this attempt are create-only, never reset, overwrite or replay; no automatic use of earlier unused budgets
excluded: Secret, KMS, IAM, OIDC or GitHub setting changes
ALB, ECS, RDS, Cell, network or DNS start/create/update/delete
Old schema/role/trigger/fence mutations or business-row reads
Instance/release seeding, business task creation or workflow dispatch
Enabling ops/releases/runtime.json, image publication, database migration or automatic cleanup
risks: Installer credentials are broad and the entire existing config file enters process memory; verified TLS does not eliminate network/provider-log or process-memory risks
Catalog DDL/role changes can briefly lock system catalogs and provider role-management hooks may reject installation; isolated PostgreSQL 16 CI is not Neon 18 installation proof
Two committed transactions and cross-connection observations are not atomic as a whole; concurrent old-catalog changes or partial installation can require later separately approved inspection
Creator ADMIN authority is retained; closing SET/INHERIT does not remove the installer administrator's ability to grant future access
Unknown submissions are not retried; committed objects are not automatically removed, reset or down-migrated
No new AWS billable resource is requested, but existing AWS storage and other resources can still incur fees and Neon usage may apply

A pg name[] decoding incompatibility is locally reproduced; casting to text[] does not prove every effective role check will pass online. Failure before/after the remaining grants must preserve the committed schema and stop without changing its privileges.

connectionChange.previous: Explicit connection fields plus startup options for default_transaction_read_only, statement_timeout and lock_timeout
connectionChange.next: Reuse the existing connection URL and verified TLS, omit startup options; all preflight/independent queries use explicit READ ONLY transactions with the original SET LOCAL query/lock timeouts
connectionChange.writerDefaultRule: Before DDL, require the session default_transaction_read_only to already be off; do not change a global or role setting
connectionChange.ddlTimeoutRule: Pinned DDL is not modified. The client has a 20-second response timeout; this does not prove server-side cancellation or rollback, so unknown submission stops without retry
connectionChange.errorRecording: Only SQLSTATE plus allowlisted startup-parameter/error categories; no raw diagnostics or credentials

executorArtifact.normalization: Exact UTF-8 bytes; one-off grants-only invocation, not a runtime installer

inspectionTypeCorrection.originalDecoder: pg returns an unparsed string, including empty array as two-character {}
inspectionTypeCorrection.guard: Still requires zero parents AND installer SET=false/INHERIT=false; no membership or privilege is ignored
